Talaria

Winged sandals of Hermes, pure transport — I/O: load 10x MEX/H5/H5AD/Loom, Seurat interop, BPCells backing, export (matrices, DE/GSEA/ORA results, interactive R Markdown widgets).

Export DE results to files

Export an interactive DE cross-comparison bar-chart widget for R Markdown
TALARIA_export_first_steps()

Export an interactive gene-expression-by-group widget for R Markdown

Export GSEA results to files

Thunderbolts forged by Hephaestus, decisive — expression: cluster markers, cell-level and pseudobulk (DESeq2) DE, GSEA/ORA (single and pairwise), propeller proportion testing.
